comments.content:
Similar to Meteor mode, but a comet would be an invincible rock that moves
on a specific trajectory across the map, destroying a 1-tile-wide swath
through the station. Should move slightly faster than, or at running speed.
Make it super hot to help cause explosions and ignite fuel and such.
What would be the objective on this? It'd be easy to avoid one comet.

Who said anything about ONE comet?

Am thinkin a new comet every minute or two; same goal as the meteor game mode (what
the heck is the goal there anyway)

So... a meteor that just keeps on trucking? I'm not sure why that would be preferred
to the current rocks - if players had a way of anticipating where they'd hit, that
might not be the case. Perhaps an enhancement could be some meteor/comet tracking
mechanisms and/or some defensive equipment to deflect some of their damage (be it
shooting them, shields, reducing their kinetic energy, etc)

Because a comet passing through the station cutting a straight swath through would
casue way mroe damage than a few tiles on the external side. It would be a
catastrophic event, instead of an exterior annoyance.

yeah we have too many cooperative modes already, they completely miss the point of
ss13 (also they're boring in general but thats irrelevant)
